Methods

AddBlockTexture(string, string)

Registers a texture (PNG on disk) that will be copied into the resource pack under textures/blocks/ and referenced from terrain_texture.json. The key must match the texture name(s) used in your block MaterialInstances (or IDestructionParticles).

public ResourcePack AddBlockTexture(string key, string sourcePngPath)

Parameters

key string

The texture key (the value used in behaviour-side material instances).

sourcePngPath string

Path to the source .png file on disk (will be copied as-is).

Returns

ResourcePack

AddItemTexture(string, string)

Registers a texture (PNG on disk) that will be copied into the resource pack under textures/items/ and referenced from item_texture.json. The key must match the Texture property on your Item definitions.

public ResourcePack AddItemTexture(string key, string sourcePngPath)

Parameters

key string

The texture key (the value used in behaviour-side minecraft:icon).

sourcePngPath string

Path to the source .png file on disk (will be copied as-is).

Returns
